entities.summary: Russian State University of Design and Applied Arts (Stroganov University) (Russian: Российский государственный художественно-промышленный университет имени С. Строганова) informally named Stroganovka (Строгановка) is one of the oldest Russian schools for the industrial, monumental and decorative art and design. The university is named after its founder, baron Sergei Grigoriyevich Stroganov.
